description: The browser vendors shipped minified by tools/minify-vendor.mjs: whitespace and local names only. Terser compression is off, function and class names are kept, property names are untouched, comments carrying a licence or copyright stay; the upstream file stays the source. A vendor with a standIn has it applied to the upstream text first (tools/minify-vendor.mjs STAND_INS). Each vendor pins the upstream bytes and the derived bytes a probe proved -- tools/probes/vendor-minify-equivalence.mjs for the pass alone, the vendor's standIn probe for a stand-in; a different upstream, Terser, option or stand-in is refused until it is proved and pinned again. Every vendor's full notice is also in agent/vendor/NOTICE.txt and the application's licences.

standIn.what: The RegExp validator gives way to the engine the structure Worker runs on: a regexp literal is valid iff new RegExp(pattern, flags) accepts it, or -- when the engine refuses -- iff it accepts the pattern with every \p{..}/\P{..} value Acorn's own tables know written as one every engine knows; refused at the pattern's start with the engine's message. Acorn's Unicode property and script tables and its identifier tables stay: the grammar is the engine's, the Unicode data is Acorn's (tasks #311 and #328).
